target_customer: B2B marketing and sales teams that run in-person customer events such as executive dinners and summits
problem: Events are run manually: sourcing attendees, invites, and then digging through notes to find leads. Pavoot connects attendees, conversations and follow-ups in one AI system.
business_model: B2B software plus managed event service; pricing not stated
product_category: AI event management for B2B pipeline

founders.name: Gohar Tamrazyan
founders.background_notes: Six-time Swiss chess champion and youngest on Switzerland's national chess team at 13, per YC page.

founders.name: Ana Yoon Faria de Lima
founders.background_notes: 20+ scientific Olympiad medals; built internal AI systems for bank data scientists. Source: YC company page.

competitors.name: Cvent
competitors.what: Enterprise event management with CventIQ AI features
competitors.traction_then: enterprise incumbent; plans reported from 10,000 USD per year

competitors.name: Bizzabo
competitors.what: Event experience platform for B2B conferences
competitors.traction_then: listed at 17,999 USD per year in one roundup

competitors.name: Luma
competitors.what: Event pages and registration for community and startup events
competitors.traction_then: Pro tier about 59 USD per month

competitors.name: Zkipster
competitors.what: Guest list management for dinners and donor events with smart RSVPs

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly workflow, CRM integration and LLM summarization of conversations; no hard research problems.

defensibility.rationale: Attendee and relationship data accumulate, but existing event platforms and CRMs can add similar AI features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cvent was adding AI features; no action against Pavoot found.

market_need_then: The YC page says companies invest more in dinners and summits because relationships drive revenue, while post-event follow-up stays manual. The site lists many customers (Deel, Stripe, Slash and others) without describing the engagements.

identity.voice_and_tone: Pipeline-focused: AI that turns events into pipeline.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive invented name but no brand press was found; the brand search returned nothing about Pavoot.

outcome_analysis: Pavoot is an active Spring 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. It pairs a service model (running dinners for companies such as Stripe and Deel per its logo wall) with software, which can win early revenue. Verified funding and revenue are not public.
notes: Aggregators (FundedIQ, Caplight, VCBacked) report about $500k, a June 2026 pre-seed or accelerator round with Y Combinator; no primary source, so not recorded as a round. Team size on YC listing is 0 (not stated). Customer logos are from the company site, not independently verified. Completeness pass: the $500K pre-seed of June 2026 is recorded from FundedIQ and rests on a single database with no press confirmation; VCBacked lists Y Combinator as an investor without an amount.
